mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can enhance the anticholinergic effects of amitriptyline and increase risk of nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, while amitriptyline may potentiate aminoglycoside neuromuscular blockade effects.
action: Monitor renal function and ototoxicity signs closely; maintain adequate hydration; use amikacin at appropriate dosing intervals adjusted for renal function; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
